who_may_register: FAQ Q2 verbatim: Researchers / Model Organism Researchers / Clinicians, Counselors, Other health care providers / Patients and their families
institutional_email: Not required. Institution is a required free-text field
vetting: None stated. Self-service, email activation link
gene_only_submission: YES. FAQ Q9: at least one of MIM number, Gene Symbol, Genomic Location, Phenotypic Features. A bare gene symbol suffices
fee: None. About page: 'GeneMatcher is a freely accessible web site'. CAVEAT: the EULA boilerplate says 'Upon User's payment of the required fees, if any' and scopes use to 'an appropriately trained clinical researcher', contradicting the FAQ
notification: Both parties emailed simultaneously with the matching info and each other's contact email. Submissions keep matching indefinitely until deleted
scale: statistics page 2026-09-16: 20,310 submitters, 117 countries, 116,446 submissions, 17,144 unique genes, 12,831 genes matched. Non-human submissions present (mouse 283, Drosophila 36, zebrafish 32)
verification: SEEN live 2026-09-16 via curl with a browser User-Agent (WebFetch gets Cloudflare 403)

who_may_register: 'If you are a scientist willing and able to perform experiments on a gene, you are eligible to register as a Scientist User'. Glossary: 'in vivo, in vitro, and/or in silico methods'
gene_only_submission: YES. You register GENES, never cases. Primary/Secondary tier, Public/Restricted privacy
fee: Match Dashboard verbatim: 'It is completely free and there are no required qualifications, just an email address verification step'. Scientist Registry fee not stated anywhere (free INFERRED from absence)
notification: Bidirectional but via TWO account types: Scientist Registry receives inbound matches; Match Dashboard initiates outbound MME queries. Register both
scale: Public genes propagate to RDMM Canada, Solve-RD Europe, AFGN Australia, and MME partners GeneMatcher, PhenomeCentral, MyGene2

who_may_register: FAQ 1.1.7 verbatim question 'I am a basic scientist and don't have any human data to share. Can I still register?' Answer: 'Yes! ... we do not require you to submit data'
institutional_email: Must be associated with a recognised academic institution
vetting: HEAVY: proof of credentials, scan of ID such as a passport, signed Code of Conduct Adherence Agreement, Data Access Committee decision 'within 10 working days', access renewed every 12 months
gene_only_submission: You get search/browse access to GPAP datasets. Pushing an MME submission requires a patient record (INFERRED)
fee: None. 'all RD-Connect services are entirely free for all users'
notification: MME participation is submitter-driven, enabled per dataset at submission
scale: Real genome-phenotype platform, not a notice board

who_may_register: Depositing requires an academic centre affiliated to a hospital, led by a senior clinician, BSGM/ESHG/ASHG membership, institutional email, lead-clinician approval
vetting: Lead clinician approves each account; all external contact requests manually vetted by DECIPHER
notification: NO ACCOUNT NEEDED TO MAKE CONTACT. Per-patient page verbatim: 'Your request will be validated by the DECIPHER team and forwarded to the clinician on your behalf.' And: 'It is not necessary to join DECIPHER to find and read open-access patient data'
scale: KIF13A gene page live 2026-09-16: 'DECIPHER holds no open-access sequence variants in this gene'; 55 matching patient variants, of which 47 copy-number and 8 other; open-access CNV records browsable, each with a Contact tab
verification: SEEN live 2026-09-16. The JSON API is closed: every /api/ endpoint returns HTTP 403 'Client key not provided'

open_to_us: NO, but there is a stated back door
who_may_register: Three criteria, the professional one being 'Be a clinician or researcher who wants to share non-identifying information on a person(s) with a rare condition'
gene_only_submission: NO. Contributor status requires 'A de-identified phenotype description and at least one candidate gene/variant'
notification: FAQ verbatim back door: 'Basic-science researchers without cases may contact us for alternatives.' Clinician and researcher profiles are PUBLIC, so KIF13A entries are browsable without an account
scale: Also runs a Variant-Level Matching network alongside MME

who_may_register: 'appropriate for clinicians and scientists who can contribute phenotype and genotype information about Patients ... under their care or being studied in their research environment'
institutional_email: MANDATORY: 'G-mail/Hotmail/Yahoo/other non-academic or non-institutional e-mail addresses etc. will not be accepted'
vetting: Manual, including a background check via LinkedIn, hospital websites and PubMed
gene_only_submission: NO. And verbatim: 'Applicants will not be provided accounts for the purpose of browsing PhenomeCentral as the software is not designed for these types of searches'
notification: No automatic alerts; matches viewed per record or in My Matches

who_may_register: Self-service via AnVIL/Terra Google registration; demo project available
gene_only_submission: NO. MME submission is per-individual from a loaded project with a joint-called VCF
fee: 'There are currently no costs associated with requests to load data from your AnVIL workspace to seqr'; AnVIL storage and compute billed separately

who_may_register: Terms of service: 'intended to be used by qualified and licensed physicians'
gene_only_submission: NO. It is a phenotype-driven (HPO) diagnosis and case-search tool, not a gene registry
NO. MME participants page: 'Given Monarch contains no patient data, no notifications of matches are sent'
scale: The endpoint listed on the GA4GH wiki, mme.monarchinitiative.org, returns NXDOMAIN (tested 2026-09-16). Monarch is absent from the current official node list on matchmakerexchange.org

who_may_register: Self-hostable open-source MME server software. The live Stockholm node accepts patients only via Scout from 'a registered and authorized collaborator' at Karolinska
'Only clinicians and researchers who join IRUD project can access and register patients' information'
scale: Japanese AMED national programme; no public registration route found for a foreign group
verification: MME participants page SEEN; exact rules UNVERIFIED, treat as closed

No public query endpoint exists
